chunks: “Whoever drinks their fill from the water of Zamzam will be granted healing through it, and an illness will be turned away from them.”

key_terms.رَوِيَ: drank to satisfaction or drank one's fill
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been transmitted or narrated
key_terms.شِفَاءٌ: healing or cure granted through it
key_terms.مَاءِ زَمْزَمَ: the blessed water of Zamzam in Makkah

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about drinking the water of Zamzam?
ai.summary: This hadith states the healing virtue of the water of Zamzam for the one who drinks from it fully. It highlights Zamzam as a blessed element associated with benefit and the repelling of illness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever drinks their fill from the water of Zamzam will be granted healing through it, and an illness will be repelled from them."
